decisions.name: system_backup_v2_admin_revocations
decisions.redacted_explanation: Only schema metadata is recorded. Installation-local token revocation cutoffs are never dumped or restored from a source backup. Existing target cutoffs must not be cleared; a new target requires fresh authentication identities before admission.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_totp_credentials
decisions.redacted_explanation: Only schema metadata is recorded. Encrypted TOTP seeds, password-binding hashes, consumed steps and throttle state never enter backup payloads or diagnostic evidence. A restored target must enroll its administrator independently; source enrollment is not transferable.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_admin_sessions
decisions.redacted_explanation: Only schema metadata is recorded. Live session digests, credential bindings, expirations and revocation flags are never dumped or restored. Current target sessions cannot be replaced with source sessions.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_metadata_reservations
decisions.redacted_explanation: Only schema metadata is recorded. Target-local monotonic capacity reservations are not copied from a backup and must never be reset by ordinary startup or statistics refresh. Any reconciliation requires a quiesced measured target baseline.

decisions.name: system_image_settings
decisions.redacted_explanation: Runtime image references must be checked against target policy and availability before activation.

decisions.name: egress_private_exceptions
decisions.redacted_explanation: User and instance references require target mapping; destination policy must be revalidated.

decisions.name: security_scan_configs
decisions.redacted_explanation: Scanner configuration is restored only after target analyzers and actor references are validated.

decisions.name: security_scan_jobs
decisions.redacted_explanation: Historical scan jobs may contain sensitive findings and actor references; nonterminal state cannot resume implicitly.

decisions.name: security_scan_job_items
decisions.redacted_explanation: Job and asset references require target mapping; nonterminal work is normalized to a non-running state.

decisions.name: security_scan_reports
decisions.redacted_explanation: Reports are confidential and remain valid only when their restored job and asset references verify.

decisions.name: audit_logs
decisions.redacted_explanation: Audit history is retained with redaction and actor mapping; backup-control audit cutoff is verified separately.

decisions.name: northbound_admin_settings
decisions.redacted_explanation: Authentication and instance-management settings require A and B review and target-side reference validation.

decisions.name: northbound_settings_audit
decisions.redacted_explanation: Settings audit history is confidential and requires actor and target-setting reference verification.

decisions.name: schema_migrations
decisions.redacted_explanation: Only applied filenames and the catalog hash are referenced; source rows and DDL are never restored.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_installation_state
decisions.redacted_explanation: Installation identity and first-enabled history are referenced for monitoring and matrix transitions; source rows are never restored.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_configs
decisions.redacted_explanation: Immutable configuration versions contain only closed scalar policy and redacted identity/version references; provider and security material is never restored.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_operations
decisions.redacted_explanation: Operation rows are the target-local idempotency and orchestration ledger; actor scope, hashes and typed result references are retained without replaying mutations.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_backups
decisions.redacted_explanation: Backup task rows are target-local orchestration and immutable artifact-reference metadata; workload capture, security material and provider implementations are not restored.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_external_actions
decisions.redacted_explanation: External-action rows preserve exact immutable non-secret request bytes, deterministic keys and provider observation hashes; replayable credentials and provider execution remain external.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_restore_drills
decisions.redacted_explanation: Drill rows keep only D-owned task state plus typed source, target-config hash and evidence references; B-owned restore inventory is not copied into the task row.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_preflights
decisions.redacted_explanation: Preflight rows retain closed orchestration state and evidence references only; check bodies and restore-target content remain with their implementing owners.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_artifact_verifications
decisions.redacted_explanation: Artifact verification rows retain task state, observed hashes and typed evidence references without embedding provider locations or verifier payloads.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_attempts
decisions.redacted_explanation: Attempt history is a target-local execution ledger with typed task and phase references; runner jobs, check bodies and provider details are not restored.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_events
decisions.redacted_explanation: Events are an append-only redacted diagnostic projection with closed detail fields; they never restore or replace owner task, operation or lifecycle authority.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_alert_states
decisions.redacted_explanation: Low-cardinality persisted alert sequences survive controller restarts but contain no resource public IDs, free labels or owner payloads.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_artifact_lease_states
decisions.redacted_explanation: The per-source lease mode and generation guard is target-local coordination metadata that makes shared and delete leases mutually exclusive without storing provider content.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_artifact_leases
decisions.redacted_explanation: Artifact leases are target-local coordination facts with typed source and holder IDs; no provider locator, credential or restore inventory is persisted.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_promotions
decisions.redacted_explanation: Promotion records are installation-local baseline CAS facts containing typed resource and immutable evidence hashes; current health is always derived and no provider, runner or signing payload is copied.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_prune_runs
decisions.redacted_explanation: Prune runs are installation-local candidate, confirmation, idempotency and CAS ledgers; strong-auth proof material and provider deletion payloads remain with their owners.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_prune_items
decisions.redacted_explanation: Prune items freeze typed object-version or catalog-tombstone identities and D-owned lifecycle state without storing provider locators, credentials or catalog payload bytes.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_maintenance_locks
decisions.redacted_explanation: Gate generation, fencing and bounded deadlines are installation-local coordination state and must start empty on a restored installation.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_maintenance_mutation_leases
decisions.redacted_explanation: Mutation leases bind writer operation identity to a gate generation and bounded database time; they are never restored or replayed.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_maintenance_participants
decisions.redacted_explanation: Participant generation, pause ACK, checkpoint and watchdog resume facts are installation-local coordination records; restored control tables must start empty.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_evidence
decisions.redacted_explanation: Evidence metadata remains a typed, encrypted control reference; neither payload bytes nor provider storage references are restored as business data.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_evidence_chunks
decisions.redacted_explanation: Chunk framing and integrity metadata is meaningful only with its evidence record and is referenced for verification, never replayed into a target.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_log_chunks
decisions.redacted_explanation: Only redacted log indexes and evidence references are retained for diagnostics; workload logs are not restored or resumed.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_dependency_health
decisions.redacted_explanation: Observed dependency health and immutable-version evidence are target-local control facts and are referenced without restoring stale observations.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_provider_capabilities
decisions.redacted_explanation: Capability probes are bound to an exact provider identity and reference version; target capability state must be observed again rather than restored.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_source_writer_check_states
decisions.redacted_explanation: Writer-inventory checks retain only versioned registry hashes, domain inventory hashes, bounded difference counts and registered evidence; every target installation must observe the writers again.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_check_results
decisions.redacted_explanation: The shared verifier envelope is target-local control metadata; owner-defined check registries and expected/actual payload schemas remain external and are never reconstructed from restored rows.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_staging_resources
decisions.redacted_explanation: Staging intents, resource ownership, immutable identity and cleanup lifecycle are target-local control metadata; resource bytes and source data are never restored from these rows.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_compact_tombstones
decisions.redacted_explanation: Compact tombstones preserve redacted idempotency and terminal hashes for control-plane safety; source operation rows are not reconstructed.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_strong_auth_nonces
decisions.redacted_explanation: Consumed nonce HMACs and request hashes are installation-local authentication replay records, never restored or exposed as proof material; A-owned verifier and wire contract remain pending.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_job_observations
decisions.redacted_explanation: Current Job generation, relay cursor, progress age and command slot are installation-local execution facts; B-owned message wire and Job execution are not restored or defined by D.

decisions.name: system_backup_v2_restore_drill_resources
decisions.redacted_explanation: Restore resource intents, owner HMACs and cleanup evidence are target-local control records; B-owned target resources and bytes are not restored or defined by D.

decisions.name: audit_events
decisions.redacted_explanation: AI Gateway audit history is retained as redacted historical evidence; actor, invocation and request references are remapped and no event resumes execution.

decisions.name: chat_messages
decisions.redacted_explanation: Chat content is confidential historical data. Restore remaps session, actor, instance and invocation references and never restores a live conversation cursor.

decisions.name: chat_sessions
decisions.redacted_explanation: Chat sessions are restored as historical session metadata with target user and instance mapping; session activity is not resumed automatically.

decisions.name: cost_records
decisions.redacted_explanation: Cost records are immutable accounting history; target identifiers are remapped and monetary/token aggregates are verified without replaying provider calls.

decisions.name: enterprise_auth_settings
decisions.redacted_explanation: Enterprise authentication policy is retained with secret material represented only by typed refs; encrypted bind credentials never enter manifest, evidence or restored active state.

decisions.name: instance_gateway_token_aliases
decisions.redacted_explanation: Gateway token aliases contain only non-reversible token hashes and expiry history; restored rows cannot become active credentials without a new token issuance.

decisions.name: llm_models
decisions.redacted_explanation: Model catalog metadata is restored with provider and secret references redacted; API key material is never copied into a manifest or evidence.

decisions.name: model_invocations
decisions.redacted_explanation: Invocation history is immutable audit and usage data; request/response bodies are redacted under the AI policy and restored rows cannot trigger provider execution.

decisions.name: northbound_auth_challenges
decisions.redacted_explanation: Authentication challenges are retained only as expired or consumed history; nonce hashes and challenge state never restore as usable login material.

decisions.name: northbound_caller_policies
decisions.redacted_explanation: Caller scopes are restored only after user mapping and closed permission validation; the target cannot inherit an unrecognized or expanded scope.

decisions.name: northbound_sessions
decisions.redacted_explanation: Northbound sessions are restored as revoked historical records; refresh-token hashes and session state cannot be used to continue a source session.

decisions.name: risk_hits
decisions.redacted_explanation: Risk detections are retained as redacted historical findings with rule and invocation references remapped; they do not re-trigger enforcement on restore.

decisions.name: risk_rules
decisions.redacted_explanation: Risk policy is restored through the closed rule schema and normalized action set; unsupported or unsafe actions are rejected before activation.

decisions.name: user_quotas
decisions.redacted_explanation: Quota policy is restored after user mapping and target capacity validation; it does not grant resources beyond the target installation limits.

decisions.name: users
decisions.redacted_explanation: Users are restored through immutable identity mapping and role allowlists; password hashes and external authentication material are redacted from evidence and never exposed in diagnostics.

decisions.name: instance_skills
decisions.redacted_explanation: Use B's shared instance and workspace mapping; preserve removals and the original observed-content difference from the library package. Do not install or synchronize skills. Validate each version belongs to the same skill and each path stays under the isolated workspace root.

decisions.name: skill_blobs
decisions.redacted_explanation: Map object locators to the isolated object target and retain source digest semantics. Compute independent streamed SHA-256 over captured bytes. A nonempty locator without content fails integrity; an empty locator requires reviewed B workspace recovery proof and is not silently accepted. No production fallback reads.

decisions.name: skill_hub_tag_assignments
decisions.redacted_explanation: Preserve exact skill/tag membership using the shared mapping. Reject missing endpoints and duplicate associations; never broaden publication or tag permissions.

decisions.name: skill_hub_tags
decisions.redacted_explanation: Preserve tag identity, key, order and admin_only restriction. Seeded tags must not be duplicated and administrator-only tags must not become publicly assignable.

decisions.name: skill_package_materialize_jobs
decisions.redacted_explanation: Preserve original rows in the encrypted backup. In the drill target, normalize pending/running to the existing cancelled state, preserve terminal history and timestamps, and map instance/skill/blob/workspace references. Never start backfill, claim or retry; unknown status fails normalization.

decisions.name: skill_scan_results
decisions.redacted_explanation: Preserve historical engine, risk, timestamps and blob references without treating them as fresh approval. Findings and summaries are encrypted payload only and redacted from evidence. Do not invoke the scanner or resume pending scan work.

decisions.name: skill_versions
decisions.redacted_explanation: Preserve every version and its skill/blob mapping, including versions not currently selected. Manifest bytes remain encrypted payload and never enter unredacted evidence. Restoring metadata must not create packages, versions or scan work.

decisions.name: skills
decisions.redacted_explanation: Preserve all skill versions, ownership, visibility and publication history through the shared identity map. Validate current-version ownership and scan-result references; never publish, install or scan during drill. Free text stays in encrypted payload only.
